reason: The done/push/shrink/drop prompt is honestly the closest anyone has come to my actual 11am collapse, so I'd start the free trial. But I've paid for three of these and quit each one. I'm not paying again until it survives a couple of real weeks against my work calendar, and that takes longer than the first month.
objection: Nothing here says it syncs both ways with my work Google/Outlook calendar. If blocks I drag in don't show up where my colleagues book me, or their meetings don't reflow my day, it's just another parallel plan I'll abandon.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of solid two-way sync with Outlook and Google work calendars, plus the end-of-block prompt actually sticking with me through the trial.
